original.statement: The ACME HTTP-01 solver was fixed to work with IPv6 endpoints.

decision.reason: [ev-4fef58672646] lists "Fix ACME HTTP-01 solver for IPv6 endpoints" as a bug fix in v1.17.0. A fixed bug means the same configuration now behaves differently, so "behavior-changed" with no before/after values fits. The change affects how the solver handles IPv6 endpoints at runtime, so the protocol-behavior family fits. The kebab-case name "acme-http01-solver-ipv6" is built only from the note's own key words.
